scripts.ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout: rimraf temp && mkdir temp && cd temp && mkdir _ss14-repo && cd _ss14-repo && git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14.git && git sparse-checkout init && git sparse-checkout set Resources/
scripts.ss14-repo:clone-checkout:stable: npm run ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin stable && git checkout stable
scripts.ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master: npm run ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin master && git checkout master
scripts.start: npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master && npm run start:noclone
scripts.start:noclone:nowiki: npm run copy-source-data && npm run convert-source-data-to-json && npm run process-converted-data
scripts.start:noclone: npm run start:noclone:nowiki && npm run process-results-for-wiki-and-upload
scripts.start:nowiki: npm run ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master && npm run start:noclone:nowiki
